title: Auto modes focus the closest subject
remedy: In P, Tv, Av or M you can select the AF point yourself and use it to focus the target subject.

source.title: EOS REBEL T5i / EOS 700D Instruction Manual
source.quote: In Basic Zone modes, the camera will normally focus the closest subject automatically. Therefore, it may not always focus your target subject.

title: Some older lenses focus slowly in live view contrast AF
appliesWhen: Live view with Face+Tracking, FlexiZone-Multi or FlexiZone-Single
remedy: Use Quick mode for these lenses (not available for movies).

source.title: EOS REBEL T5i / EOS 700D Instruction Manual
source.quote: If you use AF with any of the following lenses, using [Quick mode] is recommended. If you use the [u+Tracking], [FlexiZone - Multi] or [FlexiZone - Single] for AF, it may take a longer time to achieve focus or the camera may not be able to achieve correct focus.

title: Lens focusing noise can be recorded during Movie Servo AF
remedy: Use an STM lens such as the EF-S 18-55mm IS STM, or an external microphone.

source.title: EOS REBEL T5i / EOS 700D Instruction Manual
source.quote: With certain lenses, the lens mechanical sound during focusing may be recorded.

title: Subjects the viewfinder AF can fail on
appliesWhen: Very low contrast, very low light, backlit, repetitive patterns
remedy: Lock focus on an object at the same distance and recompose, or switch the lens to MF.
